hardInvariants: local lane ownership comes from explicit compiler node IDs rather than nearest-junction geometry
every physical network segment produces two directed right-hand lanes
route transitions use directed compiler lanes and validated connector micro-lanes only
macro graph centres/straight-line targets never become local driving geometry
same tokenId and materialization slot survive a visible junction traversal
no coordinate teleport at lane/connector/lane boundaries
no normal despawn or pool eviction while crossing a junction
cars enter outgoing roads on the correct directed lane
unsafe or tangent-discontinuous connectors are never exposed as activatable runtime lanes
U-turns are avoided when legal alternatives exist
generated topology is not hand-edited as a workaround
MacroTrafficRouteContinuityPolicy and TrafficIntentDrivingPolicy are not re-enabled wholesale
